      description: The owner's derived identifiers, grouped under the version-2 'identity' object. Each is rederived with a fixed 'V2' version tag mixed into the region code used inside the identifiers, so no value produced under version 1 is produced again.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: The owner's unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the version-2 region code derived from the postcode (the plain region code with the fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in), FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW261A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same lastName and postcode), the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2' version tag, the normalized lastName and the postcode. All owners in one household carry the same value; null for owners not part of a shared household.
          type: string
          example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: The single derived duplicate-detection key, the lower-case hex SHA-256 of 'V2' + '|' + normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + soundex(lastName). A create request whose whole identityKey equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409. Because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with different telephones have different identity keys.
          type: string
          example: '3f8a9c2e1d7b4056a1c3e5f7092b4d6e8a0c2e4f6180a3b5c7d9e1f30425364a'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When supplied it is combined with the lastName to form the salutation."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the structured addressLine1 is supplied it is preferred. Returned as the composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, plus a space and the normalized addressLine2 when addressLine2 is present)."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; a non-blank addressLine1 satisfies the address requirement. Stored and returned normalized."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the structured postal address. When present it is normalized and appended (after a single space) to the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "A 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When supplied it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is stored and used to derive the ageBand (computed against the registrationDate). Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

- `OwnerIdentity.java` — identityKey hashes `"V2" + "|" + telephone + "|" + email + "|" + soundex` (still 64-hex SHA-256).

- `openapi.yml` — removed top-level `memberId`/`householdId`/`identityKey`; added a nested `OwnerIdentity` schema (those three) as `identity`, plus a top-level integer `apiVersion`.
- `OwnerMapper.java` + new `OwnerIdentities.java` helper — maps `identity` (grouped) and `apiVersion: 2`.

- `OwnerCreatedEvent.java` — added `schemaVersion` (`SCHEMA_VERSION = 2`) and a recomputed `ownerSegment` (via `OwnerSegments.of`, whose region stays plain).
